status: Retrospective sensitivity protocol fixed before this extension was computed; not prospective registration

population.inputs: Existing frozen 15-dimensional coordinates and predictions for seeds 0, 1, 2; target excluded from standardization and predictor construction
population.additional_predictor: Within-donor diagonal location-scale interpolation: interpolate endpoint means and coordinate standard deviations at the fixed rank-time alpha=0.5; preserve source standardized residuals; empirical standard deviations use ddof=0; source coordinates below 1e-8 standard deviation remain centered at the interpolated mean
metrics: energy distance after centering each distribution by its own mean
population.matched_sampling: 50 paired draws of 200 source and 200 target cells without replacement per donor/task, seed 29; same indices for all predictors and fit seeds; aggregate donors equally
population.interpretation: Centered energy distance is a separate shape diagnostic, not an additive decomposition of energy distance; target means are used only in evaluation; computational draws and fit seeds do not increase the three-donor sample size

historical_reports: Read-only; write new CSVs and reports to outputs/computational_extension
